apiContracts: GET /api/profile returns current session user's profile and private stats
PUT /api/profile updates only session u.id after strict field validation
GET /api/account/preferences returns validated owner preferences or defaults
PUT /api/account/preferences updates only session u.id after strict allowlist validation
GET /api/public-profile/:username exposes only public, non-banned profile projection and opt-in aggregate stats

migrationPlan.backwardCompatibility: Reuse existing nullable-safe/defaulted user columns; no numbered migration added.
migrationPlan.rollbackOrForwardRepair: Revert Worker API handlers and retain user data columns; no production schema mutation.

uiLifecycle.accountEditor: Account page edits profile fields through the owner-scoped profile API; profile visibility and reading-stat opt-in are explicit.
uiLifecycle.settingsSync: Settings restore saved account preferences, debounce authenticated writes, and preserve local-device settings for anonymous/offline use.
uiLifecycle.publicProfile: API projection only in this slice

privacySecurity.authorization: Mutations derive owner exclusively from session u.id; client cannot select another account
privacySecurity.publicDisclosure: Public endpoint requires public visibility and non-banned account; excludes email, tickets and private stats
privacySecurity.abuse: Per-account rate limits on writes; strict input allowlists and length bounds
privacySecurity.audit: Profile and preference mutations emit audit events

unit: Account profile editor and preference sync UI regression markers
isolation: Two-account Worker/D1 tests remain required before runtime sign-off

flags: No feature flag or production exposure in this PR
stagingSteps: Review owner isolation and public response shape
Integrate account editor and settings sync separately

rollback.codeRollback: Revert this API-only PR before deployment.
rollback.dataRollbackOrForwardRepair: No schema changes; existing profile/preferences values remain untouched.

changeSummary: Owner-scoped profile and preference APIs using existing canonical user columns, plus public visibility-filtered profile projection.
acceptanceCriteria: Private GET/PUT operations bind only to authenticated session owner.
Public profile never exposes email, Crown balance or private data.
Reading stats are disclosed only when show_reading_stats is enabled.
No migration is added or applied.
Route and authorization evidence fingerprints match exact Worker source.
Account editor saves validated profile fields without allowing role or owner selection.
Settings restore account preferences and debounce writes while retaining local-first anonymous behavior.
Public/private selection restores correctly from the saved profile.
Service worker installs a new cache namespace for the changed browser bundle.
